note: Settings apply to the next supervised Factory NG cycle. They do not start legacy dispatcher lanes.

workers.label: Qwen local
workers.work: small evidence-complete Map work plus bounded agentic Engine work

workers.label: MiniMax M3 free
workers.work: evidence-complete Map work through the non-agentic prepared-direct adapter

workers.label: Claude (staged)
workers.work: Staged Map/Engine implementation; one coding correction. Agentic is a bounded read-only evidence helper only after explicit staged evidence failure, then implementation returns to staged.

workers.label: Claude (secondary)
workers.work: Staged Map and Engine worker; prioritized bounded five-card trial, with exact staged routing and complete-card verification. Normal work continues when no trial job is ready.

workers.label: Claude (tertiary)
workers.work: third concurrent claude-staged lease taking whichever lane (Map or Engine) has runnable backlog, to use more of the daily paced tranche

workers.label: Claude (agentic, bulk-read shunt test)
workers.work: controlled rollout 2026-09-05: same as the claude worker but whole-file Reads over 350 lines are shunted to a summarizer first, scoped offset/limit reads pass through untouched so exact-text SEARCH/REPLACE edits still work (docs/factory-ng/model-profiles/v1/claude-agentic-test.json); default SHUNT_BACKEND=llama-server (unmetered Qwen3.8 box, ~145s/read measured) or SHUNT_BACKEND=openrouter (minimax/minimax-m3:free via the shared openrouter-cooldown state, ~6s/read measured but shares the minimax-m3-free worker's rate-limit ceiling); 5% weekly-gate tranche so acceptance/repair rate can be compared against claude on live tickets before any wider promotion

workers.label: Codex
workers.work: well-evidenced Map/Engine work and focused repair

workers.label: Codex (secondary)
workers.work: well-evidenced Map/Engine work and focused repair

workers.label: Codex (third, tool-enabled)
workers.work: Third concurrent Codex lease: bounded source investigation, Map/Engine implementation and focused repair through the existing constrained harness; shares Codex quota and the secondary 70% weekly ceiling.

workers.label: Codex (fourth, staged)
workers.work: Fourth concurrent staged Codex lease: bounded source investigation, Map/Engine implementation and focused repair through the existing constrained harness; shares Codex quota and the secondary 70% weekly ceiling.
